guidance.heading: Guidance, subject to revision
section: The below guidance is for the combined Allegiant and Sun Country entity.

System ASMs - year-over-year change(5) | ~Flat
Scheduled service ASMs - year-over-year change(5) | ~+1.7%
Fuel cost per gallon | 4.75
Adjusted operating margin(1) | 6.0% - 7.0%
Interest expense(2) (millions) | ~$50
Capitalized interest(2) (millions) | (~$6)
Interest income (millions) | ~$11
Assumed tax rate | 23
Weighted average shares outstanding (millions) | 27.3
Adjusted earnings per share(1) | $1.00 - $1.50
Weighted average shares outstanding (millions) | 23.9
Adjusted earnings per share(1) | >$6.00
Aircraft-related capital expenditures(3) (millions) | $640 to $660
Capitalized deferred heavy maintenance (millions) | $75 to $85
(1) Denotes a non-GAAP financial measure for which no reconciliation to GAAP is provided as described above.
(2) Includes capitalized interest related to pre-delivery deposits on new aircraft.

(3) Aircraft-related capital expenditures include the purchase of aircraft, engines, induction costs, and pre-delivery deposits. This amount excludes capitalized interest related to pre-delivery deposits on new aircraft.
(4) Does not include repayment of pre-delivery deposit debt facilities due on delivery of aircraft

(5) Year-over-year change is calculated relative to prior-year combined entity pro forma available seat miles (ASMs) for the three months ended December 31, 2025 of 7,027,800 (in thousands) for total system and 6,427,000 (in thousands) for scheduled service
